caseName: Jones Motor Co. v. Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission
caseNameFull: JONES MOTOR CO., INC. v. PENNSYLVANIA PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION
attorneys: Roland Rice, William J. Wilcox and Christian V. Craj for petitioner., William A. Coichman, Louis J. Carter and Thomas M. Kerrigan for the Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission, respondent., Harold S. Shertz for Intervening Respondents.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted and the judgment is reversed. Service Storage & Transfer Co. v. Virginia, 359 U. S. 171.
